title: Grateful Dead Live at The Scope on 1982-04-03
lineage: Transfer: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A (Dolby-B in) > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged.
taper: Concert recording by Rip Tompkins, & with thanks to Richie Stankiewicz!
source: FOB Beyers mics > Sony TC-D5M > TDK MA-90's.

ai_review.summary: Wonderful recording of a fresh 1982 show featuring standout Loser bass work and a unique Scarlet‑Fire jam.
ai_review.review: The tape captures an engaging 1982 performance that feels both surprising and fresh, with Phil’s phased‑bass on “Loser” highlighted as a highlight and the brief but distinctive “Scarlet > Fire” transition praised. While a few moments of confusion are noted, the overall energy is high and the recording quality is described as wonderful.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed 4‑star review indicates a strong show with notable musical moments and an overall good listening experience, but limited data prevents higher confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer calls the recording wonderful; no specific issues or source details are mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set features fresh transitions, especially the concise Scarlet‑Fire jam that links the songs in a novel way.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mentioned as having swapped sides with Phil during this show.
band_member_comments.Phil: His phased bass on “Loser” is highlighted as an interesting and memorable moment.
